name: inset-panel
title: Inset panel
description: A padded panel whose images, tables and code can reach its edges: the inset cancels the padding and rounds with the corners.
docs: padding is sm (16px), md (24px) or lg (32px), and is kept in one CSS variable, --inset-panel-padding. InsetPanel.Inset cancels it on the sides you choose: x (the default), y, all, top, bottom, start or end. top and bottom also reach the sides next to them, so a picture runs across the whole top; start and end also reach the top and bottom. An inset rounds only the corners that touch the panel's edge, with the panel's own radius less its 1px border, so no sliver of background shows. Content wider than the panel, such as a table, scrolls inside the inset and never widens the panel; where scrollbars are classic the inset shows a thin, soft one.
